node.html: Authored and deployed Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to AWS for centralized logging, monitoring, and observability across GenAI platform teams — and used MCP-driven tooling to enable automated, self-service platform deployments.
Designed and deployed RAG pipelines integrating vector stores and embedding pipelines (with caching) to power grounded, production-ready GenAI features for multiple LLM-powered products.

Built and operate a central infrastructure platform — Terraform automation, EKS, GitHub Actions, and Octopus Deploy — giving multiple engineering and AI teams self-service, standardised app deployment instead of per-team, one-off pipelines.

Spearheaded enterprise Kyverno policy rollouts for multiple clients (cutting security incidents 30%, improving compliance audit scores 15%) and contributed to the open-source Kyverno project in Golang.
